add.k: Foggy's mother, who runs Nelson's Meats with her husband
st: Anna urges Foggy to come home and help Theo run Nelson's Meats, cheers his DA campaign, and decides to retire to Tampa.

files.notes: "Anna" is said in episode 9; the surname follows from her son Foggy Nelson and the family shop, and "Anna Nelson" in full appears only in the credits.

k: An FBI agent on Wilson Fisk's protective detail
An FBI agent secretly working for Fisk
st: Arinori guards Fisk, falls under his control, rounds up crime bosses for him, and dies when Dex storms Fisk's wedding.

files.notes: Name said in episodes 2, 9, 11 and 13. Coerced service for Fisk counted under Fisk's Empire.

k: A slick lawyer for Cottonmouth and Fisk
Fisk's lawyer, working to set him free
st: Donovan works to free Fisk from Rikers, quietly moves money on his orders, and sets the rules for Matt's visit.
Donovan walks Cottonmouth out of the precinct for lack of evidence, then pulls Candace out of Misty's interview.
Donovan drops Mariah when her money vanishes, later wins it back, passes on her kill orders, and reads her will to Luke.
Donovan brokers Fisk's FBI deal, gives up Vanessa's deal to Daredevil, and announces that Fisk's conviction is overturned.

files.notes: Story order follows the wiki: Daredevil S2, Luke Cage S1, Luke Cage S2, Daredevil S3. "Donovan" is said in Daredevil S2 ep 9; "Ben Donovan" in Luke Cage S2 ep 2; "Benjamin" only in credits. His firm is named on screen ("Donovan and Partners") only in Daredevil S3 ep 3, so earlier stages are Independent; he is retained counsel, not a member, of the Stokes family and Fisk's operation. Misty Knight id not known, written by name.

add.k: Melvin Potter's parole officer and girlfriend
st: Betsy heads to work despite Melvin's worry, and when Daredevil warns her to flee Fisk, she calls him no better than Fisk.

files.notes: Only "Betsy" is said (from Daredevil S1 on, in mentions); the surname Beatty is credits only, so n is "Betsy". On screen only in Daredevil S3 ep 7. Her parole office is never named: Independent.

st: Coach Bradley gives Dex a new glove and pulls him from a near perfect game, then dies when Dex's angry throw ricochets into him.

files.notes: Appears only in a past scene in Daredevil S3 ep 5, where "Coach Bradley" is said by Dex's therapist. The school or team is never named: Independent.

k: A Harlem neighbor who knows Dontrell
A widow of Fisk's Hell's Kitchen bombing
st: A neighbor tells Luke that Dontrell beats the woman next door and her son, and points him to Dontrell's dice game.
Mrs. Callahan, who lost her husband in Fisk's bombing, casts her absentee ballot for Foggy and urges him to get Fisk.

files.notes: Unnamed in Luke Cage S2 ep 2; "Mrs. Callahan" is said in Daredevil S3 ep 5. Same actor in both per the wiki.

k: An indebted cop forced into a killing to clear his debt
An indebted cop forced to do Wesley's dirty work
st: In debt and threatened through his daughter, Farnum tries to strangle Karen in her cell, then turns up shot dead at home.

files.notes: "Mr. Farnum" is said in Daredevil S1 ep 1; "Clyde" is credits only, so n is "Farnum". Forced service for Wesley counted under Fisk's Empire. Opposing hero set to Karen Page, his intended victim; Karen Page id written by name.

add.k: An NYPD officer on Wilson Fisk's payroll
st: Corbin, a cop on Fisk's payroll, kills Sergei while hunting Vladimir and is arrested after Daredevil stops his hit on Hoffman.

files.notes: "Officer Corbin" is said in Daredevil S1 ep 6 and his name tag is shown.

add.k: The judge presiding over Frank Castle's trial
st: Judge Batzer takes Frank Castle's not guilty plea, threatens the lawyers over jury selection, and keeps order as his trial unravels.

files.notes: "Judge Cynthia Batzer presiding" is said in Daredevil S2 ep 7; she first appears unnamed in ep 6. The court is never named in dialogue: Independent.

add.k: Stan Gibson's son, held and controlled by the Hand
st: Held and controlled by the Hand, Daniel is freed by Daredevil, but at Metro-General he kills his father and later bleeds out for them.

files.notes: "Daniel" is said from Daredevil S2 ep 9 (his father is "Stan Gibson"). Mind-controlled service for the Hand counted under The Hand. His death at the Farm is in ep 11.

st: Doris cheers Ben on from her hospital bed, urges him to tell his story online, and comforts Karen at his funeral.

files.notes: First seen unnamed in Daredevil S1 ep 3; "Doris" is said in ep 10 and Karen calls her "Mrs. Urich" in ep 13.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Anna tells her son Foggy that his father's arthritis is worsening and asks him to come home and help Theo with the shop. She later cheers his DA campaign video and celebrates with him before leaving for Tampa.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Anna worries that Theo cannot run Nelson's Meats alone and wants Foggy to help him. Theo joins the family as Anna watches Foggy's video, and he stays on when she and her husband retire.
stages.whoA: Her son, who runs the shop

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Arinori and Dex serve together on Fisk's FBI detail and both end up doing Kingpin's work. They clash at the church when Arinori blames Dex for failing to kill Karen. At the wedding, Dex kills Arinori with dining knives.
stages.whoA: His fellow agent, and his killer
stages.whoB: A fellow agent on Fisk's detail

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Arinori congratulates Nadeem on the Albanian raid and later shocks him by admitting that Fisk owns him too. Nadeem breaks up his fight with Dex at the church.
stages.whoB: A fellow agent turned by Fisk

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Arinori lobbies Hattley for the Fisk case and later takes Kingpin's orders through her. She sends him to round up the city's crime bosses.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Arinori escorts Fisk into the hotel and guards him, then becomes one of the agents Fisk controls. He brings Fisk the crime bosses and guards his wedding.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Donovan visits Fisk at Rikers, warning him to keep his head down while he moves money on Fisk's orders. He also draws up the rules for Matt's visit.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Donovan brings Fisk news of Vanessa and works his FBI deal. He gathers Dex's records for Fisk and announces that Fisk's conviction is overturned.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Donovan hands Matt a contract in braille that sets the rules for his meeting with Fisk. He ends the visit when Matt's time is up.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Daredevil waits in Donovan's car and chokes him with a wire until he admits Fisk is doing it all for Vanessa. Donovan then tells Fisk that Daredevil is back.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Donovan frees Cottonmouth for lack of evidence and mocks Misty's case. He then pulls Candace out of Misty's interview, and Misty calls him a snake.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Donovan gets Arturo Rey released and mocks Misty's arm. He shuts down her questioning of Mariah and later stands with Bushmaster against her.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Donovan arrives at the precinct when Cottonmouth is held over Scarfe's murder. He gets him released for lack of evidence and walks him out.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Donovan quits Mariah when her money is gone, saying he was only loyal to her money. He wins her fortune back, defends her in court, passes on her kill orders and writes her will.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Donovan represents Cockroach against Luke and sets a high price to settle. After Mariah's death, he reads her will and gives Luke Harlem's Paradise.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Betsy is Melvin's parole officer and his girlfriend, which they keep secret. Melvin fears for her as Fisk threatens her to keep him working.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Daredevil finds Betsy at work, tells her Melvin was arrested, and warns her to run from Fisk. She calls him a cold piece of work, no better than Fisk.
stages.whoB: The woman he warned to run

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Coach Bradley encourages young Dex and gives him a new glove. When Bradley pulls him from a near perfect game, Dex's angry throw kills him.
stages.whoA: His young pitcher, and his killer

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: A neighbor tells Luke that Dontrell beats his girlfriend and son. She points him to Dontrell's dice game and offers him coffee.
stages.whoA: The hero she sent after Dontrell
stages.whoB: A neighbor who pointed him to Dontrell

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Mrs. Callahan comes to Foggy's campaign event at Nelson's Meats. She tells him Fisk's bombing killed her husband and gives him her absentee vote.
stages.whoB: A voter who lost her husband to Fisk

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: A well-dressed stranger tells Farnum his debt now belongs to the stranger's employer and shows him a live feed of his daughter. Farnum agrees to do the job, and when he fails, he is killed.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Farnum slips into Karen's cell and tries to strangle her with a sheet to fake a suicide. She claws at his eye and calls for help.
stages.whoA: The woman he tried to kill
stages.whoB: The guard who tried to kill her

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Corbin's team corners the masked man at the Russian hideout, but he breaks free. Later Daredevil stops Corbin's hit on Hoffman.
stages.whoA: The masked man who foiled him

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Corbin leads crooked cops after Vladimir for Fisk and wounds him in the fight. Vladimir escapes with the masked man.
stages.whoB: The cop sent to kill him

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Corbin hunts down Hoffman, a fellow cop, and kills his bodyguards. Daredevil saves Hoffman, whose testimony gets Corbin arrested.
stages.whoA: The cop he tried to kill
stages.whoB: The cop sent to kill him

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Foggy defends Frank Castle in Batzer's court. She warns him and the DA over jury selection and hears his opening statement.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Matt defends Frank Castle in Batzer's court. When Matt puts Frank on the stand, Frank turns on everyone and she calls for order.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Reyes prosecutes Frank Castle before Batzer. Batzer pushes both sides to accept the jury and strikes the doctor's testimony after Reyes calls it a distraction.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Batzer takes Frank's surprise not guilty plea. His trial ends in chaos when he turns on the court on the stand.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Daredevil finds Daniel at the Farm and returns him to his father. When the Hand takes back its patients, Daniel flees from Daredevil.
stages.whoB: A boy he rescued from the Hand

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Claire treats Daniel at Metro-General and finds he has no fingerprints. When he wakes, she tells him he is safe and brings in his father.
stages.whoB: A patient taken by the Hand

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Doris and Ben flirt and joke in her hospital room as her illness clouds her memory. When he is fired, she urges him to tell his story online.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: At Ben's funeral, Karen blames herself for his death. Doris tells her Ben admired her and always made his own choices.
stages.whoA: The young woman Ben looked after

dropped.why: His name is never said in the dialogue (checked the full transcript) and never shown on screen; only the credits name him.
Never named in dialogue or on screen in Daredevil S1 ep 7; the name comes only from the credits.
Never addressed by name in Daredevil S3 eps 6 or 9 (only a subtitle speaker label); name is credits only.
Never named in dialogue or on screen in Daredevil S2 ep 11; name comes only from the credits.
Appears only as a corpse with no lines; he has no on-screen role beyond being the murder victim.
Never named in dialogue in Daredevil S1 eps 4 or 5; the name comes only from the credits.
Never named in dialogue in any of his Daredevil S3 episodes, not even in Nadeem's list of Fisk's agents; name is credits only.

changes.was: "An indebted cop forced to do Wesley's dirty work"
changes.now: [["An indebted cop forced into a killing to clear his debt", "Daredevil S1"], ["An indebted cop forced to do Wesley's dirty work", "Daredevil S1#4"]]
changes.why: Wesley's name is never said in Daredevil S1 ep 1 (first said in ep 4), so the line naming him is staged from ep 4.

changes.where: tie Farnum / James Wesley, Daredevil S1, text
changes.was: Wesley tells Farnum his debt now belongs to Wesley's employer and shows him a live feed of his daughter. Farnum agrees to do the job, and when he fails, he is killed.
changes.now: A well-dressed stranger tells Farnum his debt now belongs to the stranger's employer and shows him a live feed of his daughter. Farnum agrees to do the job, and when he fails, he is killed.
changes.why: Wesley is not named in Daredevil S1 ep 1, the tie's episode; his name is first said in ep 4.

changes.where: tie Ben Donovan / Matt Murdock, Daredevil S2, text
changes.was: Donovan hands Matt a contract in braille that sets the rules for his meeting with Fisk. Matt refuses his help on the way out.
changes.now: Donovan hands Matt a contract in braille that sets the rules for his meeting with Fisk. He ends the visit when Matt's time is up.
changes.why: The transcript has no moment where Matt refuses Donovan's help; Donovan cuts the visit off with "Time's up, Mr. Murdock."

changes.where: tie Cynthia Batzer / Samantha Reyes, Daredevil S2, text
changes.was: Reyes prosecutes Frank Castle before Batzer. Batzer pushes both sides to accept the jury and strikes testimony over Reyes's objection.
changes.now: Reyes prosecutes Frank Castle before Batzer. Batzer pushes both sides to accept the jury and strikes the doctor's testimony after Reyes calls it a distraction.
changes.why: Batzer strikes Tepper's testimony on Reyes's side, after Reyes argues the defense is distracting the jury; it was the defense that objected and asked for a mistrial.
